Package io.github._3xhaust.core

Class JavaUIApp

java.lang.Object
io.github._3xhaust.core.JavaUIApp
public final class JavaUIApp extends Object
The application root. Owns the renderer, the Router and the active view.

Typical usage: 

   JavaUIApp app = new JavaUIApp.Builder()
           .title("My App")
           .size(900, 600)
           .route("/", () -> new HomePage())
           .route("/users/:id", params -> new UserPage(params.getInt("id", 0)))
           .build();
   app.run();
